answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ivory of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
